decision_rationale.challenger_analysis: JSON Schema can provide structural constraints, but the core rules are contextual: change class and impact flags must agree; native and mature-alternative analysis must be present; dependency identity is conditional; subjective decisions need owner approval; and T4 must bind the validated manifest. A separate schema engine does not remove those semantics. GitHub required checks can gate protected branches, but this task's existing action workflow does not target the authoritative staging branch and the repository's project instructions prohibit unnecessary Actions runs or settings changes.
decision_rationale.tradeoffs: A small project-specific semantic validator remains, but it is attached to the existing authority and has no additional runtime package. The policy requires a classification record and tests; it does not infer subjective acceptance or validate the truth of cited claims.
decision_rationale.simplest_robust_solution: Use the existing control-model JSON, hbnf_control.py, standard-library test suite, and platform doctor; add no new lifecycle state, transition, service, package, or workflow.
decision_rationale.critical_path_reason: The change adds a fail-closed evidence check to future engineering decisions and the existing T4 progression receipt without changing product behavior or the current Phase 2 state.

decision_rationale.selected_path: Adapt the existing HBNF text overlay to use WLED FontManager font 4 (native 5x12), preserving existing host planner semantics and drawing glyphs over the current Matrix frame. Keep page timing and provisional font presentation unfrozen. Use the pre-existing final-output brightness requirement at Matrix output only.
alternatives_considered: Invoke native WLED 2D Scrolling Text as a full effect
Use FontManager directly with only paging/placement glue
Continue reading WLED PROGMEM bitmaps with a bespoke HBNF raster parser
Recover or recreate external WBF font assets
decision_rationale.challenger_analysis: The full WLED effect is mature but brings vertical motion, trail behavior, and segment/effect routing that do not match the immediate stable-hold HBNF moment contract. Direct WLED FontManager calls reuse native glyph data, width metrics, cache and pixel writes. The previous adapter read WLED font byte tables itself; removing that parser reduces bespoke work. Exact historical WBF assets are not required because the pinned upstream contains a built-in native 5x12 font. The 5x12 appearance remains provisional and unaccepted.
decision_rationale.tradeoffs: Word paging and centering remain minimal HBNF glue; oversized single words use a reversible scroll fallback. The provisional 5x12 font may be changed after owner review without changing shared contracts. Direct FontManager segment cache and ESP32 runtime cost still require target build/runtime evidence before acceptance.
decision_rationale.simplest_robust_solution: Use FontManager’s built-in font 4 and native glyph rendering; retain only word-boundary pagination, centering and the existing 2200 ms hold as provisional implementation details.
decision_rationale.critical_path_reason: This closes offline text/brightness source integration without inventing font assets or an alternate renderer and enables one offline Phase 2 build candidate. It does not authorize live mutation or final visual acceptance.

findings.statement: Supabase anonymous sign-ins create authenticated user identities without email/PII; they use the authenticated Postgres role and require RLS policies to distinguish anonymous users.
WLED documents multiple ESP outputs and PWM white, analog outputs driven through MOSFET circuitry, per-segment brightness JSON control, and WLED 16 native segment layering/transitions.

The native WLED path is the least-complex control abstraction for UV if exact AUX firmware, output pin, segment/output mapping, and independent load driver are present; none is assumed by this offline adapter.
The Phase 2 branch already contains P2 text/Vibe candidate fixtures and a guest-platform readiness audit; the WOW branch can prepare isolated contracts without editing those owned files.
UV exposure can harm skin and eyes, and UVA, UVB, and UVC are distinct wavelength bands; the product label alone does not establish the output wavelength or exposure safety.

native_capability_check.rationale: Native platforms cover guest identity, segment dimming, and style composition. Only bounded policy adapters/contracts are prepared; hardware topology and owner-selected presentation remain unverified/unfrozen. Production integration must reuse existing Supabase sessions and device-control paths. decision_rationale.selected_path: Add reversible, offline-only policy and interface artifacts in a new isolated directory; use existing Supabase anonymous auth and WLED native JSON/segment capabilities at later integration.
alternatives_considered: Supabase anonymous Auth
new guest auth/JWT service

custom PWM device protocol

custom text renderer
decision_rationale.challenger_analysis: The native facilities cover the core capabilities; a bespoke service, device protocol, or renderer would duplicate platform capability and add support burden. The strongest unresolved UV issue is physical output/load capability. The strongest text limitation is subjective treatment quality and must be reviewed by the owner.
decision_rationale.tradeoffs: Reference policy code is not production persistence and is intentionally isolated. Supabase RLS must be audited for anonymous-user role behavior before wiring. WLED JSON payloads require verified segment mapping and existing network authority. Text options need owner visual selection. UV wavelength/exposure and shielding/placement remain an explicit physical commissioning gate.
decision_rationale.simplest_robust_solution: Keep session and owner authority in current Supabase/backend; add only scope checks at existing mutation entrypoints; express UV as native WLED segment JSON; layer treatments over existing text rendering.
decision_rationale.critical_path_reason: Parallel, offline preparation can proceed without changing Phase 2 worker-owned files or lifecycle state.

findings.statement: For trusted friends physically near the cart, static QR plus the existing server-side session store and per-cart owner Guest Mode gate replaces the earlier ticket/capability/anonymous-auth draft. Guest browsers receive no direct database authority.
The filed SP803E manual documents PWM NMOS outputs on IO25, IO26, IO27 and SPI output on IO16; WLED documents multi-output ESP32 configurations and PWM white support.

findings.statement: Espressif lists ESP32 Series strapping pins as GPIO0, GPIO2, MTDI/GPIO12, MTDO/GPIO15, and GPIO5; GPIO25/26/27 are not strapping pins. This does not establish the SP803E board output circuit's dark state during reset.

The current accepted AUX output plan uses GPIO16 for the 12V addressable underglow; existing UV candidate pins are 25/26 and the spare channel is 27. The UV strip is 5V USB while AUX uses a 12V setup, and current commissioning refuses to enable UV without physical verification.
findings.source_ref: SP803E current project commissioning contract and runbook

findings.statement: AUX can likely host an independent PWM UV channel beside the GPIO16 addressable bus using native WLED output configuration, but safe 5V load wiring on the 12V-powered board, no-backfeed, boot-dark behavior, installed firmware configuration, segment mapping, and optical exposure remain unproven; software therefore remains disabled with cap 0.

native_capability_check.rationale: The simplified guest flow needs no new identity provider or guest authorization subsystem; a small adapter can call the existing server session and cart-action paths. WLED and the SP803E board have the native PWM/output family, and the candidate GPIOs are not ESP32 boot strapping pins. UV remains off until board-level fail-dark behavior, the exact existing load topology, firmware config and optical exposure are verified.

decision_rationale.selected_path: Implement an isolated static guest page and dependency-injected backend adapter around current session/mode/action interfaces. Keep Guest Mode disabled by default. Keep UV policy native-WLED-facing and disabled, while recording existing SP803E PWM channels and precise wiring/readback gates.
alternatives_considered: Supabase anonymous Auth and RLS grants
single-use QR ticket and scoped capability framework
existing Cart server sessions and owner mode flag
custom guest JWT/session server
SP803E onboard PWM channels with native WLED outputs
custom PWM protocol or firmware
decision_rationale.challenger_analysis: The prior ticket/capability solution added authentication and revocation machinery not required by the updated small trusted-friends context. Static QR is not itself a security boundary; the live owner gate and server-side session are. For UV, the board manual disproves the assumption that no PWM/MOSFET channel exists, while the manual's load-supply guidance and the 5V/12V mismatch prevent claiming the existing output is safe to wire now.
decision_rationale.tradeoffs: Guest trust boundary is deliberately contextual and the session relies on the current backend store; its process-local debounce is only suitable on a single backend instance unless replaced by the host's existing shared limiter. UV output wiring/configuration remains a physical qualification task. Existing Phase 2 files remain untouched.

decision_rationale.challenger_analysis: The measured FPS regression alone did not prove a missing patch. The built header and build manifests show the R4 transformed input was absent, while the prior R4 runtime and pinned closure establish a compatible mature path. The proposed change restores that path; it does not remove Phase 2 features. A live run remains necessary to establish actual performance on the combined candidate.
decision_rationale.tradeoffs: The new artifact grows relative to the rejected image and must be checked against the exact app partition. Runtime frame rate cannot be certified offline.
decision_rationale.simplest_robust_solution: Use the existing R4 helper and exact FastLED pin with a narrowly scoped PlatformIO include path.
decision_rationale.critical_path_reason: The exact R4 FastLED source closure is required to restore the proven Phase 2 performance baseline before any new bounded runtime qualification.
